body: Temporary Claude-reviewer availability rule. Greg's words, relayed verbatim by Engram::Advisor6219 in TermAl mailbox mailbox-2f563cf1-5f83-40eb-a593-3a470306ab54 #42, message mailbox-message-56c1154e-8cb3-4e85-9b19-58ef1ebe0163, 2026-10-06T19:46:42.111067100Z: “Kimi zastępuje Claude, aż będą tokeny”. Advisor's scope statement: until Claude reviewer capacity returns, Kimi replaces a required Claude review refused for token or weekly capacity. Record the actual refusal; keep the independent read-only Kimi reviewer, the Codex reviewer, the exact frozen input, and normal validation requirements. This extends the earlier Stage A-only exception to the stated temporary availability condition; it is not an unrestricted substitute choice. Retirement trigger: confirmed return of Claude reviewer capacity, then the normal Codex/Claude pair resumes; retain historical refusal/substitution evidence. No broader authority, source change, automatic reviewer retry, commit/push, install/restart or relaxed validation is inferred. This is an attributed record of Greg's word via Advisor, not an edit to repository authority instructions; their applicable landing and integration conditions still apply.
